description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into a Mailchimp audience via the native upsert endpoint. `PUT /lists/{list_id}/members/{subscriber_hash}` atomically creates or updates based on the member's email.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Mailchimp list member (upserted via email).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_upserted / rows_errored). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Mailchimp.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

list_id.label: List Id
list_id.description: Mailchimp audience (list) ID to upsert members into.

email_column.label: Email Column
email_column.description: Upstream column holding the member email (Mailchimp match key).

merge_fields_map.label: Merge Fields Map
merge_fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Mailchimp merge field tag (e.g. FNAME, LNAME).

tags_column.label: Tags Column
tags_column.description: Upstream column holding tags to apply (list, or comma-separated string).

status_if_new.label: Status If New
status_if_new.description: Status to set when creating a new member.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Overall safety cap on rows per run.

name: Mailchimp Member Upsert
